scope: 20 packets from 14 remote videos and six local short-clip policies; overlapping sources
visual symbols and trajectory transport are retained at their existing measured costs
compression restores existing packet bytes before decoder and trajectory checks
no neural inference, new video quality evaluation or default adoption
8dB is a small reliability diagnostic, not a packet-error-rate benchmark

conclusions.comparison: Additional savings relative to each completed NTSCC+ run, retaining visual symbols and original trajectory cost.
conclusions.quality: Original bytes at decoder entry are identical in successful transmissions; neural decoding and video generation were not repeated.
conclusions.low_snr: At 8dB all 40 original and 40 compressed transmissions failed integrity; no low-SNR reliability improvement demonstrated.
conclusions.implementation: Opt-in envelope and validator implemented; default BSU transport unchanged.
conclusions.priority: Full-packet zlib outperformed 5-bit packing and combined packing plus zlib on this corpus; use lossless length-based selection including raw fallback.
